Cast & Crew:
Director: Sudeep Mehta
Producer: Sudeep Mehta
When the last star falls, the world plunges into freezing darkness. Eight-year-old Wily, rescues the dying star and sets out to return it to the heavens, guided by an ancient reindeer, a nervous groundhog, and an injured bear, all of whom he stubbornly refuses to lean on.
